sva: p_pready_response_valid: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && penable |-> pready);
intent_summary: Every APB access phase should receive a ready response.

sva: p_invalid_address_behavior: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && penable && !(paddr inside {8'h00, 8'h04}) |-> pslverr);
intent_summary: Invalid APB addresses should report slave error.

sva: p_write_updates_reg0: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && penable && pwrite && pready && paddr == 8'h00 |=> reg0 == $past(pwdata));
intent_summary: Writes to address 0x00 should update reg0.

sva: p_write_updates_reg1: assert property (@(posedge pclk) disable iff (!presetn) psel && penable && pwrite && pready && paddr == 8'h04 |=> reg1 == $past(pwdata));
intent_summary: Writes to address 0x04 should update reg1.
